_about: What locals know: notes a newcomer only finds out by trying, written by hand for one country at a time and never templated across countries. A country with no notes shows nothing. Each note is a label of at most seven words over one fact of at most 140 characters; at most five notes a country.

GB.label: Registering is fast, payroll is not
GB.fact: Registering online takes an afternoon; setting up payroll takes longer.

GB.label: The headline rent is not the rent
GB.fact: On a strong high street, rates and service charge can add a third to it.

GB.label: Small premises often pay less
GB.fact: Each of the four nations runs its own rate relief for small premises.

GB.label: The first hire triggers a pension
GB.fact: A first employee means pension auto-enrolment: budget for it from the first payslip.
